lana-vasiljeva.title: Chief Marketing Officer
lana-vasiljeva.bio: As a Chief Marketing Officer at LLA Designer I am passionate about creating engaging marketing initiatives that drives brand growth with diverse approach to the audience.

jermaine-odtujan.name: Jermaine Odtujan
jermaine-odtujan.title: Sales Coordinator
jermaine-odtujan.bio: He excels in managing sales databases, coordinating sales activities, and providing exceptional administrative support to sales teams. His proactive approach and strong communication skills make his a valuable asset in ensuring seamless collaboration between sales, marketing, and other departments.

kate.name: Kate
kate.bio:
Kate is the Global Strategy Director at Connect Group. 
She is specialized in company formation, international business 
expansion and employee relocation. 
She studied in Southampton (United Kingdom) and moved 
to the UAE in 2014.

nakul.name: Nakul
nakul.bio:
Nakul Sachdeva is Head of Recruitment at Connect Resources. 
His expertise has crossed multiple categories and channels with functional 
expertise in a variety of industries. He has 10 years of career 
in executive search firms and supported end to end Recruitment for Major Banks, 
Financial Institution, 
IT and Consulting firms based out of Toronto, Canada and Dubai, UAE. 
He manages end to end Recruitment at 
Connect Resources as well as serves as the client’s initial point of 
contact when seeking recruiting services.

timothy-patridge.name: TIMOTHY PATRIDGE
timothy-patridge.title: Enterprise Development
timothy-patridge.bio:
Tim is a Business Development Manager at Connect Resources. 
Seeking out new business opportunities for the company by building and 
Maintaining Relationships with partnerships/connections both locally and 
internationally. Tim has a background in Logistics, working in the UK 
for a number of years at large Organizations.

alexander-m.name: Alexander M
alexander-m.bio:
Alex joined Connect Group as a Document Controller couple of years back. 
He is in charge of all controlled documents for the company, 
making sure everyone is on the same page when they need to be. 
He also create, design and maintain the architecture for document 
processes and procedures and enforce the proper 
chain of action and document identification. 
Alex go through all confidential documents and make edits, 
updates, and check for accuracy. Once this process is completed, 
he will approve the documents and distribute it to the right team. 
He also ensures proper labeling, numbering, and 
accessibility of the documents to all team members.
